samples.xml_description:
Implement a 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier. Clock signal. Active-low reset signal. Multiplicand. Multiplier. Product. 4 Register for active-low reset signal. Register for clock signal. Register for valid signal. Register for multiplicand. Register for multiplier. Register for product. Register for partial product. Register for register.

Reset the registers.

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin     rst_n_reg <= rst_n;     clk_reg <= clk;     valid_reg <= valid;     mul_a_reg <= mul_a;     mul_b_reg <= mul_b;     mul_out_reg <= mul_out;     partial_product_reg <= partial_product;     register_reg <= register; end

Calculate the partial products.

always @(*) begin     for (i = 0; i < size; i = i + 1) begin         partial_product[i] = (mul_b[i] == 1) ? (mul_a << i) : 'd0;     end end

Calculate the final product.

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin     if (~rst_n_reg) begin         mul_out_reg <= 'd0;     end else begin         mul_out_reg <= register_reg;     end end

Calculate the register.

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin     if (~rst_n_reg) begin         register_reg <= 'd0;     end else begin         register_reg <= partial_product_reg + register_reg;     end end
